decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records that the surrounding letterforms must adapt to the fixed approved Hero V geometry; no additional updates or removals are required.
A same-message MODIFY already captures that complete-wordmark refinement must preserve the approved Hero V and adapt the accent and surrounding letters to it.
A same-message MODIFY already establishes the approved Hero V as the fixed alignment reference and requires repositioning or adapting the É accent without changing the Hero V.
The second V already must derive from the exact approved Hero V geometry. The source reports an implementation deviation in the Hero V but does not change the second V's requirement state.
The unified terminal rule remains valid unchanged. The source clarifies which form must remain fixed during alignment but does not alter the required shared terminal treatment.
Restoring and preserving the approved Hero V geometry does not change the existing brand-expression goals or visual-tone constraints.
The source concerns geometric restoration and alignment, not the deferred champagne-gold material treatment or its design hierarchy.
The decision preserves the Hero V foundation but does not change the requirement for a wordmark-led identity without a separate icon or monogram.
